absent: Full layout of the secure backing page and numeric offsets of its fields.
Hypervisor exchange message format and completion semantics for forwarded writes.
Numeric values of destination forms, delivery modes and control bits.
UV memory mapped register addresses and bitfield definitions.
Read path behavior for secure registers and the OEM table validation helper.
Initialization of graphics address range bounds and ISA range predicate details.
Complete UV translation table construction and socket to node mapping algorithm.
Callers and timing of teardown, vector update and end of interrupt paths.

findings.text: Secure virtual interrupt backend offers capability probe, per CPU setup and teardown plus a full signalling family for one CPU, CPU mask, mask without self, all with self, all without self and self only, together with register write, end of interrupt, controller register access and allowed vector update under one controller descriptor.

UV platform layer offers an ACPI table OEM check entry, getters for system type and hubless identity, predicates for UV presence and hubbed generation membership, a formatter combining architecture identity with table identity, an undefined register handler and a page attribute range predicate.

Controller writes decode destination form, vector and delivery kind. Self form affects only the local CPU, all including form affects self plus every other online CPU, all excluding form affects every other online CPU, and directed form targets the CPU named by the high half. Non self cases also forward the combined wide value to the hypervisor while the combined value is always retained locally. Non maskable requests use a dedicated request flag while fixed requests pend the vector.

Directed signalling resolves a logical CPU number to its hardware identifier before issuing a physical request. Mask signalling walks the supplied set and optionally skips the caller. Broadcast helpers use the matching destination form with a zero destination. Self signalling uses a dedicated self path that bypasses destination lookup.

Register writes are classified. Timer and local vector entries are forwarded to the hypervisor. Task priority, end, spurious, non maskable request, error and extended entries are stored in the per CPU backing page. Controller writes become controller transactions with a zero high half. Self requests use the self path. A bounded allowed pending window accepts stores only on a defined stride and all other offsets report an unknown register error.

End of interrupt locates the highest active in service vector for the current CPU. Absence triggers a one time warning and no further action. Level triggered vectors clear in service state locally and forward an end indication to the hypervisor for re evaluation on return, while edge vectors use the native hardware end primitive.

Probing succeeds only when the platform reports secure virtual interrupt capability. Extended APIC mode is mandatory and its absence terminates. Allocation of the per CPU backing page is mandatory and failure terminates. Setup copies the hardware identifier into the backing page, registers the page physical address with the hypervisor and then enables handling with enable and non maskable permission. Teardown disables through the control register and unregisters the address.

UV discovery state holds a small parameter block with identifier shift and mask, socket shift, node mask, address shifts and socket counts, plus separate globals for system type, hubbed and hubless bit sets, graphics range bounds, hub identifier view, node number, minimum hub revision, architecture and vendor strings and a node zero hub record with a controller descriptor.

Per CPU UV records and a hub pointer list support early node zero initialization. Boot only translation state holds socket and node minima and maxima, range table length, range and parameter tables, bidirectional socket node and physical node maps and a range table. Blade count and clock rate live in dedicated globals.

Architecture identity comes from the firmware system table when revision permits and otherwise falls back to the ACPI vendor string after bounded copy with trailing blank removal. One vendor prefix selects hubbed, an alternate prefix selects hubless, anything else means not UV. Hubless encodes generation in low bits. Hubbed maps generation strings to revision bases and hubbed bit sets, rejects disabled NUMA, refreshes hub type from hardware and then derives mode, node, socket and time state while installing range and non maskable hooks.

Node and socket derivation reads early mapped registers for address map configuration and hub node identity, derives socket counts, masks and shifts with generation specific adjustments, defaults the guest address shift, obtains the package domain shift from topology with a fallback note when absent, and evaluates BIOS time sync where newer generations are declared asynchronously resetting, valid state is recorded as reset tolerant, unknown leaves state unchanged and any other value marks time unstable. APIC mode follows extended mode enablement.
Broadcast to all other online CPUs and masked fan out both execute with interrupts saved and disabled across the whole CPU iteration. Directed single CPU paths show no such guard in these fragments.

Lifecycle entries are probe for capability detection and allocation, per CPU setup for identifier copy registration and enable, and teardown for disable and unregister. Platform entries are the ACPI OEM check during table parsing and the memory block size command line parser with its block order installer.

Secure handling moves from absent to probed and allocated, then per CPU to enabled after registration, then back to disabled after teardown. UV system type moves from none to legacy or extended during early classification. Time handling moves to reset tolerant or unstable depending on the BIOS report. Hubbed versus hubless classification is latched in bit sets during OEM processing.

End with no active vector warns once. Writes to unrecognized secure offsets log an error. Probing without extended mode or with allocation failure terminates the guest. Undefined hub registers either panic or log critically based on a default suppressing flag and return an all ones value to induce a fault. Disabled NUMA aborts UV enablement. Missing address map configuration warns. Invalid memory block size falls back to a safe order.
Allowed pending window spans one hundred twelve bytes from its base and only every sixteenth byte offset after a four byte bias is storable; other offsets in the span are treated as unknown.

Empty socket sentinel is the all ones sixteen bit value. Default memory block size is two gibibytes with command line override, downward halving to preserve base alignment but never below the minimum block size, and order derivation through find first set with fallback to order thirty one on bad input.
